method: Read-only source and installed UE5.8 engine implementation review; no gameplay/runtime verification claimed.

verified_design.contract: Ability owns timer, query, hit sets and execution counter; EndAbility ResetRuntimeState clears timer/hit sets. CurrentNode transition resets both. No separate new collider runtime manager/component.
Original duration windows are processed using every crossed baked key and interpolated endpoints; once-per-target set prevents damage per sample. Multiple independent windows provide repeated hits.

TransitionToNode and cross-entry ApplyEdge flush old collision time before switching. Node-time is montage position minus entry-section start and allows automatic section chains (SpinningAttack02/ChargeAttack04).
Box actual center/extents/rotation authoring must consume proven BoxSemantics, not raw attachment center. Cylinder/default shape authoring remains explicitly temporary.

findings.risk: Queued montage ended callback may occur after active montage instance references were cleared. Montage_GetPosition returns0 when no active instance remains; final crossed window can be lost under a large hitch. Ordinary early attack windows usually finish before this edge.
findings.suggestion: Allow completion-time override through last authored node attack window endpoint; preserve execution guard and do not sweep unrelated montage sections. Parent informed; later source may already incorporate fix.

findings.risk: Extent.GetMin()>0 requires unused Sphere Y/Z even schema says Sphere X only. Cylinder max(X,Y) radius compared through broadphase box(X,Y,Z) misses expanded radial side when X!=Y.
findings.suggestion: Validate only dimensions consumed by shape; Cylinder broadphase should use radius in both X/Y. Author equal X/Y currently avoidsCylinder issue.

findings.risk: Raw Group1/Group2 reused across repeated OverFury animation segments must be namespaced per animation cycle/attack cohort, or repeated intended hits can be deduplicated for whole node. Overlapping windows belonging same group within cohort should share.

Box sweeps use current sample rotation rather than a continuous rotation sweep; Cylinder uses sampled overlaps. Dense original 2-4ms baked samples reduce gap, but this does not prove native collision trajectory equivalence. Original channel/wall/team/re-hit event behavior unverified.
